QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_66

question.text: Fund AUM: Peak INR 720 crore (March); Trough INR 540 crore (June); Subsequent recovery to INR 700 crore. Maximum Drawdown:

explanation.text: The Logic: Maximum Drawdown = (Trough Value - Peak Value) / Peak Value = (540 - 720) / 720 = -180 / 720 = -25%. The Trap: Option B is computed from (peak - recovery)/peak and ignores the trough. Option A inverts the base. Option D uses the wrong base entirely. Note: MDD should be compared against benchmark MDD over the same window for context, and on its own does not indicate recovery time.
